subject.title: feat(cron): emit session.maintenance.pruned diagnostic event on reaper pruning

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `session.maintenance.pruned`, `openclaw.session.maintenance.pruned`, and `openclaw_session_maintenance_pruned_total` as the supported additive diagnostics contract for cron-session pruning?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but event and metric identifiers become durable operator-facing contracts; repository history points to a diagnostics owner who should confirm their naming and semantics.

options.title: Approve the additive contract
options.body: Accept the trusted count-only event and both exporter names after direct post-prune exporter proof is added.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep pruning telemetry but revise the event or metric names and semantics before they become supported identifiers.

options.title: Defer the metric
options.body: Leave the existing text log as the only signal until the diagnostics taxonomy is defined elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive contract
recommendation.body: Accept the trusted count-only event and both exporter names after direct post-prune exporter proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows sustained ownership of trusted diagnostic events, OTEL semantics, and the Prometheus exporter.
